title: Ideogram Vector 1.0: editable logos as real SVGs (Oct 22, 2026)
text:

title: Rick Chorney, 29: AI took his cleaning company from $242K to $1.3M
text:
Real story. A 29-year-old cleaner used AI to go from $242,000 to $1.3 million. 🧹

Rick Chorney co-founded Echo Janitorial Services in Abbotsford, British Columbia, in 2023. ChatGPT polished his emails. Claude became his business advisor. Perplexity for research, Grok for content. A $99-a-month AI receptionist answers the phones instead of a $4,000-a-month hire.

$242K two years ago. Just under $1M last year. On track for $1.3M this year. Workdays went from 19 hours to eight.

He didn't build an AI company. He put AI under a cleaning company.

title: How to sell AI vector files on Etsy, step by step
text:
You asked: how to sell AI vector files on Etsy. 📐

1. Pick a lane: SVG cut files, logo templates or sticker sheets for one niche.
2. Make it with Ideogram Vector 1.0, then clean it in Inkscape (free) or Canva.
3. Prove it: Etsy's Oct 22 rules want your creative role stated, the AI disclosed and a real preview. Cut one on vinyl and photograph it.
4. List it: have Claude write the title, 13 tags and description. Bundle 10 to 20 files.

The math: a $6 bundle leaves you about $5 after Etsy's fees. Twenty sales a week is roughly $400 a month. Sales, not guaranteed.

title: The $99 AI receptionist for any service business
text:

One saved $300 job a month pays for a year of the add-on. Tell callers it's an AI; some states require it.

title: Claude in Google Sheets: the $150 spreadsheet cleanup offer, step by step
text:
Most watched last week: Claude in Google Sheets. Here's how to turn it into a paid offer. 📊

1. Every small shop has a spreadsheet nobody trusts. Offer a one-time cleanup for $150. Ask for a copy, never the live file.
2. In Sheets: Extensions, Claude. 'Standardize dates, split names, flag duplicates, add a monthly totals tab with a chart.' Keep 'ask before edits' on.
3. Add a Summary tab: top five expenses, months over budget, three recommendations. Export to PDF.

Upsell: a $50 monthly refresh. Six clients is $300 a month of recurring work.

Claude Pro is $20 a month; the add-on needs a paid plan. Check every formula before you send.

title: Hob 0.2: free desktop AI that runs offline (Oct 26, 2026)
text:
A free desktop AI that runs offline, so client files never leave your laptop. 🔒

Oct 26: Hob 0.2, a free open-source app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It picks an open model that fits your machine, like Gemma or gpt-oss, and sets it up.

Bookkeepers, virtual assistants and paralegals with NDA files can finally use AI on them. Try: drop in a client contract and ask for the payment terms and deadlines.

Small local models are weaker than ChatGPT or Claude. Good for sorting and summarizing, not legal advice. Free, MIT license, no account.

title: Three AI agents a one-person business can run for under $20 a month each
text:
You asked: three AI agents a one-person business can run for under $20 a month each. 🤖

1. Competitor watch: Perplexity Computer Automations (Pro, $20). 'Every Monday 7am, check these five competitor sites and email me the changes.'
2. Inbox sorter: Gemini tasks mode (AI Pro, $19.99) or Claude Duet. 'Each morning, sort new email into Leads, Invoices, Noise. Draft replies. Wait for my OK.'
3. Bookkeeper: Claude in Google Sheets (Pro, $20). 'Each month, pull the new rows, flag anything unusual, update the summary tab.'

The rule: one agent per job, and each one pauses for your approval before anything sends or gets paid. Agents break when websites change; spot-check weekly.
